resources.string: Double-tap anywhere to capture your screen
Fast — requires quick taps (less false triggers)
Relaxed — more time between taps (easier to trigger)

To get started:

1. Tap the button above
2. Find "DoubleTap Screenshot" in the list
3. Toggle it ON and confirm

Once enabled, double-tap anywhere on your screen to take a screenshot. Nothing visible is added to your screen.

Double-tap anywhere on your screen to take a screenshot.

A short vibration confirms the capture. There is a 2-second cooldown between screenshots to prevent accidental triggers.

If you get too many false triggers, switch to "Fast" speed above.
Detection is paused. Tap Resume to start capturing screenshots again.
Detects double-tap gestures anywhere on screen and takes a screenshot. Nothing visible is added to your screen. The service does not collect or transmit any data.
